In the [[mathematics]] of [[topological vector space]]s, '''Minlos's theorem''' states that a [[cylindrical measure]] on the dual of a [[nuclear space]] is a [[Radon measure]] if its [[Fourier transform]] is continuous. It is named after [[Robert Adol'fovich Minlos]] and can be proved using [[Sazonov's theorem]].
